item.title: Version 1.2
item.description:
JazzDeinterlacer 1.2

  • Parallel rendering — long exports are split into segments rendered at the same time and joined without re-encoding, so ProRes uses every core. Preferences → Files → Render sets the number of segments (automatic by default).
  • Batch queue: deinterlace and IVTC settings per file — algorithm, field order, output rate, comb sensitivity, smoothing, ghost tolerance, flash detection, IVTC phase and conform.
  • Batch queue follows the main window — new files start from the settings active in the main window; "Use Main Window Settings" copies them onto selected files.
  • Batch status control — Reset Status to render a finished file again, Skip / Unskip, Reset All, Remove; right-click any row.
  • Clear batch progress — current file with frames, fps and remaining time, plus an overall bar for the queue.
  • Fix: "+ Batch" could queue an output path equal to the source file; batch outputs now use the same descriptive suffix as Render, and the queue refuses an output equal to its source.

item.title: Version 1.1
item.description:
JazzDeinterlacer 1.1

  • Real-time playback — a RAM cache and master-clock engine play even QTGMC at full speed; JKL shuttle (2×/4×/8×), forward and reverse play with audio.
  • Before / After Wipe — compare source and result in one viewer with a draggable divider, during play or frame-by-frame.
  • Comb-Detector Sensitivity — one slider that cleans up residual interlace lines on slow or noisy areas, shared by every algorithm.
  • Pixel-aspect (PAR) correction — 1:1 / 4:3 / 16:9 display for SD tape sources.
  • QTGMC detail recovery and a working Smoothing control.
  • Customisable keyboard shortcuts and Open Last (⌘⇧O).
  • Frame-stepping now matches playback for every algorithm; source audio starts instantly across sessions; DV/AVI fixes.
